key_insight: Teacher improvements from RL transfer to students only when supervision is stratified by what both teacher and student can actually sample correctly, rather than by teacher strength alone.
engineering_relevance: For training reasoning models, TS-OPD offers a practical way to allocate distillation signals by competence level, improving macro-average correctness without relying on a uniformly stronger teacher.
method: Screen problems by joint sampled success of student and teacher.
Route acquisition examples to gated forward KL and consolidation examples to gated reverse KL.
Add an entropy brake to preserve sampled coverage during distillation.
evidence_signal: The paper compares teacher lineages before and after GRPO, multiple student scales, direct GRPO, and several on-policy distillation objectives on mathematical reasoning tasks, finding TS-OPD strongest for macro average correctness with the GRPO-improved teacher.
watch_item: Pass@K gains are less consistent, so the method may improve average accuracy without uniformly improving top-k diversity or sampling breadth.
paper_title: Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation for RL-Improved Reasoning Teachers
